description: This PHP source file defines the ScreenPermissionService class, which manages permissions related to screens in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for retrieving screen permissions, accessing screens, and handling module and screen information within the authorization service layer.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionService
classes.description: A service class that handles screen permission retrieval and management in the authorization layer of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getScreenDao
methods.description: Returns a ScreenDao instance, creating one if it does not exist.

methods.name: setScreenDao
methods.description: Sets the ScreenDao instance used by the service.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionDao
methods.description: Returns a ScreenPermissionDao instance, creating one if it does not exist.

methods.name: setScreenPermissionDao
methods.description: Sets the ScreenPermissionDao instance used by the service.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for a specified module and action URL, based on user roles.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Fetches a Screen entity based on module and action URL.

methods.name: getCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the current module and screen context.

methods.name: getCurrentScreen
methods.description: Fetches the current screen entity based on current module and screen context.
